help.title: Help & contact
help.q1: Is Rattil wa Salli really free?
help.a1: Yes. Rattil wa Salli has no ads, no subscriptions and no purchases, and it will stay that way.
help.a2: The Quran text, tafsir, prayer times, qibla, adhkar, tasbih and your bookmarks all work offline. Recitations stream from the internet unless you save the surahs first (More → Downloads).
help.q3: Why do the prayer times differ from my mosque?
help.a3: Mosques use different calculation methods and add a few minutes for caution. Choose your country's method and Asr school in the prayer settings, and adjust each prayer by minutes if needed.
help.q4: How do I change the reciter or the speed?
help.a4: In Settings → Recitation, or from the player itself while a recitation is playing.
help.a5: On this phone only: bookmarks, khatma, worship tracker and settings never leave it unless you turn on account sync yourself.
help.q6: Why did the adhan not sound?
help.a6: Allow notifications for Rattil wa Salli and, on Android, "alarms and reminders". Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery: exclude Rattil wa Salli from battery optimisation.
help.q7: I found a mistake in a text. What should I do?
help.a7: Use "Report a mistake" under the dhikr, or write to us below. Religious texts come from published sources and go through a review.
help.contactPending: The contact address will be added soon.

setup.title: Set up the app
setup.intro: A few steps so prayer times are right and the adhan reaches you on time, even with the app closed. You can change all of this later in Settings.

setup.exactBody: Turn on "Alarms & reminders" for this app, otherwise Android may delay the adhan by a few minutes.
setup.batteryBody: So battery saving does not stop the adhan while the app is closed: in the list choose Rattil wa Salli, then "Don't optimize" or "Unrestricted".
setup.batteryOem: On some phones (Xiaomi, Oppo, Realme, Huawei, Vivo) also turn on "Autostart" or "Background activity" on the app's page.
setup.silentTitle: Adhan when the phone is silent
setup.silentIos: On iPhone the system lets no app play a notification sound while the silent switch is on (Apple allows it only for emergency and health apps). The adhan alert then shows without sound; keep the silent switch off to hear it.
